# MoneyForever

## [v0.4](https://github.com/laric/MoneyForever/tree/v0.4) (2026-11-22)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/laric/MoneyForever/compare/v0.3...v0.4) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/laric/MoneyForever/releases)

- Merge pull request #2 from laric/fix/session-reset-on-login  
    Reset session gold on fresh login and group Forever characters by ruleset  
- Reset session gold tracking on a fresh login  
    sessionStart was persisted and only set when zero, so the session total accumulated across logins. Reset it on initial login; reloads and zoning keep the session.  
- Group Forever characters by ruleset instead of subrealm  
    Forever runs on a megaserver with many subrealms, so realm is not a useful  
    grouping key. Derive PvE/PvP/RP PvE/RP PvP/Hardcore from C\_GameRules and use  
    it as the group key, migrating old per-realm records on login. Retail keeps  
    grouping by realm.  
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>  
- Add workflow\_dispatch trigger to releases.yml
